title: token-summary usage
description: Body of a 200 answer from GET /v1/sessions/{session}/bundles/hya-extra%2Ftoken-summary/usage. A 400 (bad query) or 500 (the usage read failed) answers { "error": string } instead.

session.description: The session the endpoint was called for.

scope.description: `tree` (default) covers the session and every descendant subagent session; `session` only its own log.

models.description: Per-model totals over every covered session, sorted by prompt_total + output descending, then model name.

sessions.description: One row per covered session, breadth-first from the requested session.

truncated.description: Present only when the 512-session cap cut the tree.

cache_creation.description: Prompt tokens written to the provider cache.

cache_read.description: Prompt tokens read from the provider cache.

thinking.description: Thinking share of output; null when any contributing call did not report it.

visible_output.description: Visible share of output; null under the same condition as thinking.

unsplit_output.description: Output of calls whose thinking split is unknown.
